thread:
maya: Heads-up — staging promotion is blocked by CI. ui-smoke acceptance failing after the pre-commit build hook was added to the pipeline. Failing fast on the browser connect step.

deploybot: Promotion blocked: pipeline #4521 · job ui-smoke FAILED (timeout). Logs: https://ci.example/4521 · see job output.

rob: Can someone paste the failing snippet? I want to check if it's infra flake or test regression.

maya: Log excerpt:

```
TimeoutError: Browser did not connect within 120 seconds
  at connect (/workspace/tests/ui/smoke/test_runner.js:47:12)
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
  ---
  BUILDER IMAGE: ghcr.io/redwood/wheels-builder:python-3.11@sha256:8a7f3c...
  NODE: chromium:117.0.5938.62
```

jordan: That BUILDER IMAGE digest changed in yesterday's wheels job (https://github.com/redwood-inference/pkgs/...). We pushed a newer python-slim base that may have swapped the chromium binary variant. Seen similar flakiness when the headless binary mismatches the Puppeteer version.

sasha: Two immediate options:
- revert the pre-commit change in the release branch (slow, needs PR + approvals), or
- pin wheels-builder image digest in the CI pipeline to the previous working digest (fast, temporary).

priya: Pinning in CI sounds safest to unblock promotion quickly. We should also create an issue and a short release note entry saying we pinned the builder image and will follow up.

rob: Agreed. Jordan — can you confirm the previous digest and a quick CI snippet to override? If you post the exact env var I can trigger a manual rerun.

jordan: Previous digest: sha256:13f9d2e... Use this snippet in the pipeline config to override the image for the wheels step:

```yaml
jobs:
  build-wheels:
    image: ghcr.io/redwood/wheels-builder@sha256:13f9d2e...
    steps:
      - run: make wheels
```

Or set CI variable WHEELS_BUILDER_IMAGE=ghcr.io/redwood/wheels-builder@sha256:13f9d2e... for the run.

maya: I'll update the staging pipeline variable now and kick a rerun. Adding an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/789 (temp-pin-wheels-builder)

rob: When we rerun, can we do a canary promote (single-zone) rather than full promotion? I want to limit blast radius if it still fails.

sasha: Deploybot only supports staged promote with canary for this cutoff window. We'll run canary first then full promote on green. @deploybot please start the manual rerun once the var is set.

priya: For release notes: short line:
"Temporary: pinned wheels-builder image in CI after staging ui-smoke timeout. Root cause under investigation; follow-up tracked in infra#789."

deploybot: Manual rerun queued: pipeline #4521 (override WHEELS_BUILDER_IMAGE=ghcr.io/redwood/wheels-builder@sha256:13f9d2e...). Running canary promote when green.

maya: Thanks — monitoring the run. Will post results here. :eyes:

rob: :thumbsup: please also add a postmortem tag to infra#789 if we see repeated flakes.

deploybot: Build update: ui-smoke job PASSED in rerun. Canary promote started.

maya: Canary is green. Proceeding with full promote after a 10m observation window. I'll update the release note and link infra#789 in the changelog entry. :shipit:

priya: Logged the release note in the CHANGELOG PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/102 — mentions temporary pin and follow-up.

rob: Great coordination. After promote, let's schedule a meeting with the wheels team to confirm the chromium binary compatibility matrix.

sasha: Noted — I'll set up a 30m sync tomorrow.

deploybot: Promotion complete. Release unblocked.
